skipped.reason: no card in Forge's cardsfolder has more than one instance of squad, so payments for several instances cannot be told apart in a game

scenarios.title: A creature with squad creates a token copy for each time the squad cost was paid

setup.notes: Zephyrim is {3}{W} 3/3 flying vigilance with squad {2}. Its miracle ability is inert here.

decisions: A casts Zephyrim and pays its squad cost {2} twice, tapping eight Plains in total. It resolves.
Its enters trigger goes on the stack if it fired; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: paid_twice
variants.expected: The squad trigger fires. Two tokens that are copies of Zephyrim are created: A controls Zephyrim and two Zephyrim tokens, each 3/3 flying vigilance.

variants.label: paid_once
variants.delta: A pays the squad cost {2} once, tapping six Plains.
variants.expected: The squad trigger fires and creates one token copy: A controls Zephyrim and one Zephyrim token.

variants.label: not_paid
variants.delta: A does not pay the squad cost, tapping four Plains.
variants.expected: The squad trigger does not fire. A controls only Zephyrim, no token.

scenarios.forge_notes: The token copies do not themselves have a squad payment, so they create nothing when they enter.
